name: Infreemation Volunteer
shortDescription: A UK-developed volunteer onboarding, approval, training and event-booking system for organisations needing configurable recruitment workflows and a volunteer portal.
suitableContexts: Churches with structured volunteer application, approval and training workflows
Churches needing to track event bookings and mandatory volunteer training
Church charities that need a general-purpose volunteer system rather than a church member database

pricing.summary: The reviewed public product page does not publish an amount. The supplier describes site licensing with unrestricted users and volunteers, and says both volunteer-portal and administration functions are included. Request a written quote covering subscription term, implementation, training, data migration, SMS or email costs, support, renewal and exit arrangements.

tiers.label: Site licence
tiers.detail: Supplier says its software is licensed by site and gives unrestricted access, but does not publish an Infreemation Volunteer price.

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier provides a free-trial request route; duration for this specific product is not stated on the reviewed volunteer page.

gdprInformation: Digital Interactive Ltd publishes a general data-protection statement and says its dedicated servers and customer data are UK-based. Its volunteer page also makes a supplier compliance claim. Those public statements are useful starting evidence but do not establish that a particular church's use, retention, vetting process or safeguarding policy is compliant. Obtain the current contract, DPA, security material, retention schedule, data-export process and sub-processor list before entering applicant, identity-document or vetting information.
coreFeatures: Unlimited volunteers, events and users according to supplier
integrations: Online training can be uploaded or linked; confirm supported formats, providers and data flows
importExport: No public import/export format was found in the reviewed product material; obtain a sample export and migration plan before adoption
support: Supplier provides a free-trial request route
Supplier says a system overview is included and training can be supplied separately
Supplier publishes business-hours contact details and an email support address

uk-operator.value: Digital Interactive identifies itself as Digital Interactive Ltd, company 05189963 registered in England; Companies House records the company as active.

volunteer-workflow.value: Supplier describes end-to-end sign-up, vetting, approval, training, event booking, a volunteer portal and custom application workflows.

commercial-model.value: Supplier says volunteer-portal and administration functions are included, and its FAQ describes site licences with unrestricted access; the reviewed material does not publish an amount for Infreemation Volunteer.

data-handling.value: Supplier says its dedicated servers and customer data are in the UK, and publishes a general data-protection statement that describes processor obligations and authorisation for further processors.

editorial.assessment: Infreemation Volunteer is a general UK volunteer-administration product with more emphasis on applicant intake, approvals and training than a simple service rota. That may suit a larger church or church charity with a repeatable recruitment process, but it is not church-specific software. The product page's references to ID and CRB-check documents mean a church should be especially careful: a feature that accepts evidence is not proof that its safeguarding process, retention policy or handling of sensitive data is appropriate.

Teams managing recurring volunteer events with an applicant-to-approved-volunteer workflow

procurementVerdict.problem: Managing a structured volunteer application, approval, training and event-booking process
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK-built general volunteer system that joins application workflow, training requirements and volunteer self-service
